# Bibliographie structurée

Le fichier `catalogue.csv` est la source exhaustive et filtrable de cette version. Cette bibliographie rassemble le socle humain de lecture ; les titres sont conservés dans la langue officielle de publication afin d'éviter les traductions ambiguës.

## JCGM et BIPM

- JCGM. 2008. *Evaluation of measurement data — Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement*. JCGM 100:2008. [Anglais](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM100-2008E) ; [français](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM100-2008F).
- JCGM. 2026. *Nonlinearity in measurement models*. JCGM 100:2008/Amd.1:2026. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/PPDI3267).
- JCGM. 2008. *Propagation of distributions using a Monte Carlo method*. JCGM 101:2008. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM101-2008).
- JCGM. 2011. *Extension to any number of output quantities*. JCGM 102:2011. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM102-2011).
- JCGM. 2012. *The role of measurement uncertainty in conformity assessment*. JCGM 106:2012. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM106-2012).
- JCGM. 2023. *Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement — Part 1: Introduction*. JCGM GUM-1:2023. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGMGUM-1-2023).
- JCGM. 2026. *Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement — Part 5: Examples*. JCGM GUM-5:2026. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/YNLY8209).
- JCGM. 2020. *Developing and using measurement models*. JCGM GUM-6:2020. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGMGUM-6-2020).
- JCGM. 2012. *International vocabulary of metrology — Basic and general concepts and associated terms (VIM)*, 3e édition. JCGM 200:2012. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM200-2012).
- BIPM. 2026. *The International System of Units (SI Brochure)*, 9e édition, version 4.01. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.59161/AUEZ1291).
- BIPM. 2025. *Measurement comparisons in the CIPM MRA: Guidelines for organizing, participating and reporting*. CIPM MRA-G-11, v1.2. [PDF](https://www.bipm.org/utils/common/documents/CIPM-MRA/CIPM-MRA-G-11.pdf).

## ISO/IEC — socle de laboratoire et management

- ISO/IEC 17025:2017, *General requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/66912.html).
- ISO 10012:2026, *Quality management — Requirements for measurement management systems*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/10012).
- ISO/IEC 17043:2023, *Conformity assessment — General requirements for the competence of proficiency testing providers*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/80864.html).
- ISO 13528:2022 et ISO 13528:2022/Amd.1:2026, *Statistical methods for use in proficiency testing by interlaboratory comparison*. [Norme](https://www.iso.org/standard/78879.html) ; [amendement](https://www.iso.org/standard/90057.html).
- ISO 17034:2016, *General requirements for the competence of reference material producers*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/29357.html).

## ISO — statistiques, étalonnage et GPS

- ISO 5725-1:2023 ; ISO 5725-2:2025 ; ISO 5725-3:2023 ; ISO 5725-4:2020 ; ISO 5725-5:2025 ; ISO 5725-6:1994. Série *Accuracy (trueness and precision) of measurement methods and results*. Les statuts détaillés figurent dans `catalogue.csv`.
- ISO 21748:2017, *Guidance for the use of repeatability, reproducibility and trueness estimates in measurement uncertainty evaluation*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/71615.html).
- ISO 28037:2026, *Determination and use of straight-line calibration functions*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/84405.html).
- ISO/TS 28038:2018, *Determination and use of polynomial calibration functions*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/66349.html).
- ISO 11095:1996, *Linear calibration using reference materials*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/1060.html).
- ISO 14253-1:2017, ISO 14253-2:2011/Cor.1:2013 et ISO 14253-5:2015. Série GPS sur inspection, règles de décision et incertitude.
- ISO 33403:2024, *Reference materials — Requirements and recommendations for use*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/84224.html).
- ISO 33405:2024, *Reference materials — Approaches for characterization and assessment of homogeneity and stability*. [Notice](https://www.iso.org/standard/84226.html).

## ILAC et EA

- ILAC P9:01/2024, *Policy for Proficiency Testing and/or Interlaboratory Comparisons Other than Proficiency Testing*. [Politiques ILAC](https://ilac.org/publications-and-resources/ilac-policy-series/).
- ILAC P10:07/2020, *Policy on Metrological Traceability of Measurement Results*. Même répertoire.
- ILAC P14:09/2020, *Policy for Measurement Uncertainty in Calibration*. Même répertoire.
- ILAC G8:09/2019, *Guidelines on Decision Rules and Statements of Conformity*. [Guides ILAC](https://ilac.org/publications-and-resources/ilac-guidance-series/).
- ILAC G17:01/2021, *Guidelines for Measurement Uncertainty in Testing*. Même répertoire.
- ILAC-G24:2022/OIML D 10:2022, *Guidelines for the determination of recalibration intervals of measuring equipment*. [PDF](https://www.oiml.org/en/files/pdf_d/d010-e22.pdf).
- EA-4/02 M:2022 rev.03, *Evaluation of the Uncertainty of Measurement in Calibration*. [PDF](https://european-accreditation.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/EA-4-02.pdf).
- EA-4/18 G:2021 rev.01, *Guidance on the level and frequency of proficiency testing participation*. [PDF](https://european-accreditation.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/EA-4-18.pdf).
- EA-4/21 INF:2026 rev.01, *Guidelines for the assessment of the appropriateness of small interlaboratory comparisons*. [PDF](https://european-accreditation.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/EA-4-21.pdf).

## EURAMET et OIML

- EURAMET. 2021. *Guide on Comparisons*. Guide No. 4, version 2.0, G-GNP-GUI-004/v2.01/2021-04-27, ISBN 978-3-942992-64-0. [Répertoire officiel — lien No. 4](https://www.euramet.org/publications-media-centre/euramet-guides).
- EURAMET. *Calibration Guidelines*. [Répertoire officiel](https://www.euramet.org/publications-media-centre/calibration-guidelines).
- OIML V 1:2022 (E/F), *International vocabulary of terms in legal metrology (VIML)*. [PDF](https://www.oiml.org/en/publications/vocabularies/en/files/pdf_v/v001-ef22.pdf).
- OIML G 19:2017, *The role of measurement uncertainty in conformity assessment decisions in legal metrology*. [PDF](https://www.oiml.org/en/files/pdf_g/g019-e17.pdf).

## Théorie et guides pédagogiques

- Taylor, B. N. ; Kuyatt, C. E. 1994. *Guidelines for Evaluating and Expressing the Uncertainty of NIST Measurement Results*. NIST TN 1297. [NIST](https://www.nist.gov/pml/nist-technical-note-1297).
- Bell, S. 2001. *A Beginner's Guide to Uncertainty of Measurement*, Measurement Good Practice Guide No. 11, Issue 2. [NPL](https://eprintspublications.npl.co.uk/1568/).
- UKAS. 2024. *The expression of uncertainty and confidence in measurement*, M3003, Edition 6. [PDF](https://www.ukas.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/M3003-The-expression-of-uncertainty-and-confidence-in-measurement.pdf).
- Mari, L. ; Carbone, P. ; Petri, D. 2012. “Measurement Fundamentals: A Pragmatic View”. *IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement*, 61(8), 2107–2115. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TIM.2012.2193693).
- Cox, M. G. 2002. “The evaluation of key comparison data”. *Metrologia*, 39(6), 589–595. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1088/0026-1394/39/6/10).
